description: Wood from Date Tree; exact attribute table not fully documented.

name: Branch
description: A generic branch gathered from trees, plants and dry bushes. It keeps the same material name regardless of source.

description: Strong reed/stalk material used in fiber crafting.

name: Fig Log
description: Fruit-tree wood material from Fig Tree.

description: Flax fiber used to make thread and fabric. The reviewed sources record Soft Surface and High Elasticity as the main possible positive rolls.

name: Joshua Tree Log
description: Desert tree wood material from Joshua Tree.

name: Leaf
description: A generic leaf gathered from trees and plants.

name: Ocotillo Flower
description: Flower gathered from Ocotillo and used as a plant/decoration or herbalism material. Exact recipe use varies by version.
notes: The source is documented in the reviewed community plant/resource references. No specific attribute was established in those references.

name: Poisonous Plant
description: Plant material from poisonous tree sources. It should not be treated as an edible food item.

name: Roots
description: Generic root material gathered from raspberry bushes, Joshua Tree, Root Tree and other documented root sources.
location: Raspberry Bush / Joshua Tree / Root Tree

name: Liquid Rubber
description: Liquid rubber gathered in rubber-tree crater areas.

name: Tropical Flax
description: Tropical flax fiber used for tailoring. The Master Sheet records a fixed Thin attribute and also documents Soft Surface / High Elasticity possibilities.

name: Stalk
description: Generic stalk gathered from plants/bushes. The archived Durango Wiki lists stalk-type materials as gatherable from bushes such as Reed Bush and Flex Bush; this is not a tree log.
whereToGet: Bushes / plant gathering (community reference: Reed Bush, Flex Bush)
notes: The community wiki groups generic Stalk with Strup Stalk, Durable Stalk and Flex as bush-gathered materials. Exact plant-specific drop mapping and fixed attributes are not confirmed in the reviewed sources.
